message: `$table_model` with {count} lookup expressions, i.e. a {count}-dimensional table
description: Only one dimension is implemented. The LRM's recursive isoline scheme (§9.21) would return a number for any lookup point, and a wrong number here is indistinguishable from a right one: the model would simply converge to the wrong answer.
actions: Reduce the data to one independent variable.
Or interpolate the other dimensions in Verilog-A and pass the result as the single lookup expression.
